checks.command:
python3 - <<'X'
import pathlib, re, sys
new = [p for p in pathlib.Path('skills').glob('*/SKILL.md') if p.parent.name != 'commit']
assert len(new) == 1, new
t = new[0].read_text()
m = re.match(r'---\n(.*?)\n---\n', t, re.S)
assert m, 'no frontmatter'
fm = m.group(1)
name = re.search(r'^name:\s*(\S+)', fm, re.M).group(1)
assert name == new[0].parent.name, (name, new[0].parent.name)
d = re.search(r'^description:\s*(.+)$', fm, re.M).group(1)
assert 'use when' in d.lower() and len(d) <= 1024, d
X
